Title: Azure Time Series Insights now supports AAD groups

Body.Content:
Azure Time Series Insights support for Azure Active Directory (AAD) groups is now generally available. This integration allows you to use AAD security groups and  M365 groups while setting up access policies for your Time Series Insights environment. You can do it through Azure Portal, ARM template or Command Line Interface . 

Read the documentation.

Learn more about using CLI to set access policies
